# The Original Three — Reference Models v003

Closer interpretation of the cover and real clay trio supplied by the user.
Brown-gray tall cat ghost, squat blue blob, wide red-orange ghost.
Oversized cream eyes with irregular dark crescents; simple mouths; no fangs.
Embedded materials and geometry. Static meshes, +Y up, +Z front, base-center pivots.
These are modeled interpretations, not photogrammetry scans or exact replicas.

- Moss: The tall brown-gray cat ghost. File: moss-reference-v003.glb
- Blu: The curious blue blob. File: blu-reference-v003.glb
- Ember: The wide red-orange ghost. File: ember-reference-v003.glb

Original procedural meshes created for the five-senses project. Previous variants remain archived in v002.
